dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, tell me about your job at the restaurant. What were you responsible for?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈtɛl miː əˈbaʊt jʊr ˈdʒɑːb ət ðə ˈrɛstərɑːnt. ˈwʌt wɜːr juː rɪˈspɑːnsəbəl ˈfɔːr?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: In my first year, I just served customers. Later, I was in charge of training new staff.
dialogue.reading: ɪn maɪ ˈfɜːrst ˈjɪr, aɪ dʒʌst ˈsɜːrvd ˈkʌstəmərz. ˈleɪtər, aɪ wʌz ɪn ˈtʃɑːrdʒ əv ˈtreɪnɪŋ ˈnuː ˈstæf.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: How many people did you train?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaʊ ˈmɛni ˈpiːpəl dɪd juː ˈtreɪn?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: About ten. I showed them how to take orders and how to handle difficult customers.
dialogue.reading: əˈbaʊt ˈtɛn. aɪ ˈʃoʊd ðɛm ˈhaʊ tə ˈteɪk ˈɔːrdərz ənd ˈhaʊ tə ˈhændəl ˈdɪfɪkəlt ˈkʌstəmərz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Have you ever led a team?
dialogue.reading: hæv juː ˈɛvər ˈlɛd ə ˈtiːm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. Last year, at an English camp for village children, I led a small team of volunteers.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ˈlæst ˈjɪr, ət ən ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈkæmp fər ˈvɪlɪdʒ ˈtʃɪldrən, aɪ ˈlɛd ə ˈsmɔːl ˈtiːm əv ˌvɑːlənˈtɪrz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: What were you in charge of there?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt wɜːr juː ɪn ˈtʃɑːrdʒ ʌv ˈðɛr?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I was responsible for planning the games, and I managed all the supplies.
dialogue.reading: aɪ wʌz rɪˈspɑːnsəbəl fər ˈplænɪŋ ðə ˈɡeɪmz, ənd aɪ ˈmænɪdʒd ˈɔːl ðə səˈplaɪz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: How did you handle problems in the team?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaʊ dɪd juː ˈhændəl ˈprɑːbləmz ɪn ðə ˈtiːm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I listened to everyone first, and then we found a solution together.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈlɪsənd tə ˈɛvriwʌn ˈfɜːrst, ənd ˈðɛn wiː ˈfaʊnd ə səˈluːʃən təˈɡɛðər.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Good. In this position, trainees manage small projects. Would you be comfortable with that?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd. ɪn ðɪs pəˈzɪʃən, ˌtreɪˈniːz ˈmænɪdʒ ˈsmɔːl ˈprɑːdʒɛkts. wʊd juː bi ˈkʌmftərbəl wɪð ˈðæt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, of course. I'd love to be in charge of my own project.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, əv ˈkɔːrs. aɪd ˈlʌv tə bi ɪn ˈtʃɑːrdʒ əv maɪ ˈoʊn ˈprɑːdʒɛkt.
